status: running; thresholds fixed before any sweep arm finished
hypothesis: With the V2 60-day training window and recipe fixed, validation quality depends on the epoch share (samples seen / training pool) rather than on the raw step count: beyond the 0.601-epoch baseline used by V1/V2, more passes improve RankIC and lower turnover until a knee; the batch-64/9,900-step arm separates 'more passes over data' from 'more optimizer updates' because it keeps 1.322 epoch share at half the updates.

factors.held_fixed: network, lr 1e-4 constant, CSZ labels, lookback 128, 8 clocks, target scaling, MSE, batch order seed rule

decision_rule.seeds: shape read from seeds 11/29; any promotion needs seed 47 completed as well
decision_rule.window_aggregation: three research windows; paired daily differences per window, 5-day moving-block bootstrap 95% interval, pooled per-seed mean
decision_rule.minimum_improvement: 3-seed mean paired RankIC difference must have a 95% interval excluding zero; the noise floor is 2x the measured cross-seed sd of the 60d/9000 baseline (0.002285 -> 0.0046) and the interval criterion is used instead of a fixed percentage
decision_rule.turnover_guardrail: mean turnover must not exceed the 60d/9000 three-seed mean plus one cross-seed sd (1.2018 + 0.1193 = 1.3211)
decision_rule.knee: the smallest epoch share whose gain over the next larger share is inside one standard error is treated as the knee; steps beyond the knee are not promoted

ensemble_readout.rule: equal-weight average of the three seeds' scores on identical keys (existing FixedSeedEnsemble convention), evaluated on the same windows; reported as a deployment option, not as a promotion claim
ensemble_readout.expectation: seed-averaging should shrink the 0.0023 RankIC seed dispersion and the 0.12 turnover dispersion

notes: Sweep arms are trained on the matpool A4000 container; multi-window replay uses frozen weights and identical keys per window. No final/confirmation range is opened.
